final: WITH hand_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN TRIM(COALESCE(p.throws, '')) = '' THEN '' ELSE p.throws END AS hand, COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_id) AS player_count FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY hand), shares AS (SELECT player_count, 1.0 * player_count / SUM(player_count) OVER () AS share FROM hand_counts), compared AS (SELECT player_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(player_count), AVG(share), AVG(share - average_share) FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
